verdict.rationale: Plaid's product page claims a 'Confirm liveness' capability that ensures a person is present and that their face matches the image on the provided ID. That covers the core of selfie-to-portrait matching with liveness, but only as a single marketing-level claim with no technical documentation. missing for 10: documented defenses against printed photos, screen replays, and replayed video; technical docs on the liveness method (active vs. passive, certification such as iBeta/ISO 30107-3); face-match thresholds or result fields; independent or hands-on corroboration.
